scope: The complete JavaScript GDI bridge after the flag-day non-text semantic purge.

permanentNonTextBridge.name: gdi_set_region_bands
permanentNonTextBridge.boundary: Upload WAT-owned canonical region bands into the derived compositor clip mirror.

permanentNonTextBridge.name: gdi_set_window_rgn
permanentNonTextBridge.boundary: Apply an already-derived region mirror to browser window composition.

permanentNonTextBridge.name: gdi_surface_create
permanentNonTextBridge.boundary: Allocate a derived Canvas cache for an opaque WAT-owned surface and byte layout.

permanentNonTextBridge.name: gdi_surface_delete
permanentNonTextBridge.boundary: Discard the derived Canvas cache for an opaque surface ID.

permanentNonTextBridge.name: gdi_surface_attach
permanentNonTextBridge.boundary: Attach an opaque WAT-owned window or popup-overlay surface to its compositor Canvas.

permanentNonTextBridge.name: gdi_surface_upload
permanentNonTextBridge.boundary: Upload a bounded dirty rectangle from authoritative WAT pixels to Canvas.
